jobs.title: Data Analyst - Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
DRW
is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW
is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Data Analyst – Business Intelligence role will join DRW’s Unified Platform (UP) Data Management team. UP systems are responsible for data that spans the trade lifecycle: from research, execution, through to post-trade. Our business operations generate substantial data each day. Our global footprint produces inquiries from stakeholders that require complex answers. Questions can span years of data, multiple data stores and a variety of financial domains.

This is a reporting and analysis role at the intersection of finance, trading operations, and data engineering. The work is deadline-driven; your outputs go to regulatory authorities, external auditors, and firm leadership.

What You'll Do

Answer business questions with data

Build and run extracts against the firm's data stores to answer requests from the front office, and other units like Tax and Legal
Drive improvements to market share reporting and analytics
Support quarterly and annual tax and regulatory inquiries across multiple global jurisdictions
Respond to audit, litigation, and class-action data requests, often under short turnaround

Make the numbers trustworthy

Validate every extract before delivery — cross-foot detail against aggregates, reconcile against source systems, and investigate discrepancies rather than explaining them away
Document the business rules behind each report, including who made the decision and why

Reduce the recurring load

Identify patterns across incoming requests
Partner with engineering teams to translate those patterns into durable solutions: reporting dashboards, self-service views, scheduled reports
Write the specification: define the business logic, the edge cases, and the validation criteria that a tool needs to get right

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years in a data analysis, business intelligence, financial reporting, or analytics engineering role
Advanced SQL — you are comfortable with complex multi-table joins, aggregation across different grains, CTEs, and reasoning about query performance.
Python for data work — pandas, database connectivity, and building repeatable scripts rather than one-off notebooks
Experience working with financial data: trades, positions, pricing, or reference data
Demonstrated care with accuracy.
Clear written communication — you'll be explaining methodology to accountants, lawyers, and auditors who don't read SQL
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field
Experience specifying requirements for engineering teams, or building BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to tax, VAT/GST, or regulatory reporting

The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $130,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Financial Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst
to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha
offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.

Core responsibilities:

Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.

Stakeholder partnership:

Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.

Programs/initiatives:

Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.

Process, tools, and reporting:

Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.

Continuous improvement / strategy:

Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.

Job Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required. Primarily Finance and minor in Technology

Experience:

One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.

Skills & Competencies:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.

The Company

This is an opportunity to work with the Best
. We are Michael Best & Friedrich, LLP
. We are a full-service law firm with more than 350 lawyers and technical professionals who work in collaborative, interdisciplinary practices to serve clients around the world.
We work with companies in all kinds of industries, as well as trade associations, nonprofits, educational institutions, governments, family trusts, and high-net-worth individuals. Since our firm’s founding in 1848, we’ve continuously evolved to meet our clients’ changing needs and expectations. One thing remains the same: For generations, clients have relied on Michael Best for exceptional legal service and business acumen.

The Location

We have offices in Wisconsin
(Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha); Illinois
(Chicago); Utah
(Salt Lake City); Colorado
(Denver, Broomfield); Texas
(Austin); North Carolina
(Charlotte, Durham, Raleigh, Wilmington); California
(Los Angeles); Nebraska

(New York City); and Washington DC
. Our contemporary office spaces are ideal for concentration and collaboration; supporting our culture of working together to make great things happen for our Clients. This position can be based in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee, or Waukesha offices.

Why You Should Apply

At Michael Best, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that provides a variety of resources designed to enhance its employees’ overall well-being, both at work and at home. Competitive base pay, outstanding benefits, opportunities for learning and growth, programs designed to help you plan for the future, and perks that inspire your downtime are all part of our total compensation package.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Robert Half is representing a food manufacturing client in downtown Chicago on an open contract, with potential to be contract-to-hire, Data Analyst
opportunity. The ideal candidate is local to the Chicagoland area, but potentially open to fully remote options.

Responsibilities include:
Building out Excel dashboards
Financial modeling and forecasting in Excel
Overlap support with sales and marketing teams
Heavy sales data spreadsheet manipulation

The ideal candidate has:
Advanced Excel skills
Strong analytical skills
Experience with forecasting, cost analysis, data reconciliation & vendor management
Trade management/commercial finance experience
Strong communication skills
A startup mentality and comfortability with a startup environment
Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry experienced highly preferred, if not then related food/beverage manufacturing or retail industry experience

Benefits available to contract professionals include medical, vision, dental, and life and disability insurance. Hired contract professionals are also eligible to enroll in our company 401(k)plan. Our specialized recruiting professionals apply their expertise and utilize our proprietary AI to find you great job matches faster.
